verdicts.reason: The two banners are almost identical, with a reasonable left-to-right order: headline, phone, CTA, fine print. Both share the same flaws. The phone is shrunk to a meaningless sliver, so its score and bars can't be read. The fine print is wrapped into a cramped three-line stack whose size is close to the CTA's, so it competes with it. Both also crowd the right edge. A's headline is slightly larger, which gives it a bit more hierarchy. B keeps the original 'Try It Free' capitalisation, but its smaller headline and the CTA jammed against the phone make it marginally weaker.
